notes.title: THE FORGOTTEN PRE-ORDERER
notes.content:
[h2]BOSS RUSH[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528333/86b7ff579376b8ed0b1f2377837a44f5530162c4.png[/img]
The bosses are furious and want a rematch! Fight powered up versions of them back-to-back!

[h2]NEW BOSS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528333/5dc454d8112ccc737487a856cacb1bb39ceb9704.png[/img]
Matzesu has been waiting DECADES for his Pyra. He's mad about it and has a big sword.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sorcerer's beam now does fixed damage instead of rapidly draining health
[*] Slightly increased delay between Sebastien's attacks
[*] Smoother animation blending (barely noticeable)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For Feb 19
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added ability to remap some actions on game controllers and keyboard + mouse
[*]Added menu navigation keys to dpad, page up, page down, home, end, return, backspace
[*]Fixed bug that caused bosses to not activate when idle enemies held doors open
[/list]
